named_blockers.repair: Installed the production C9 command port and exact postgres.c9_projection_rebuild.v1 writer binding, admitted only rebuild_projection, and seeded task-tenant C9 capability/grant/approval/step authorization for the exact request digest. The effect rebuilt generation 1 transactionally and read back three local sinks; replay and negative paths are stable. This remains local-only and non-authoritative; external provider sinks, production data, release and remote publication remain out of scope.
Added /api/v1/successor-runtime to protected prefixes and reran authenticated successor middleware admission.
Derived one local Stage4 backend/Celery image from retained r13x and live-checked startup plus Secure/HttpOnly cookie serialization; retained r13x image remains unchanged.

Production cold-start assembly selects EngineProjectScopeResolver and EngineC9QueryReadPort with the trusted authenticated actor; focused PostgreSQL scope/readback, cross-tenant rejection, and no-write command binding pass. Rebuilt derived backend/Celery runtime returned an exact seeded projection_snapshot (scope fields exact, three candidate sinks, generation/cursor readback) and rejected foreign tenant requests. This closes only the local scope/query item; it does not admit effectful commands.

Bounded task-local TLS edge now passes CA-verified handshake, trusted proxy request, and clean tls_denied spoof rejection; this does not establish public certificate, DNS, remote ingress, or production authority.

conclusion: Stage4 local runtime, bounded TLS/trusted-proxy behavior, representative upgrade/backfill, authenticated journeys, and the required task-tenant C9 effectful command/readback/idempotency/failure paths are evidenced. The result is a local PASS only: the C9 writer and authority records are task-scoped, external sinks are declared loss/no-call, and no production, remote publication, signing, provider or authority transfer is established.
